title: Siege of Aalborghus
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Aalborghus", at revision 1370738438, opens: "The siege of Aalborghus occurred from 21 July to 4 August 1644 during the Torstenson War between Denmark and Sweden." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q139940102, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Torstenson War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
